Inherent things can't be removed. But the Second Truth says the origin CAN be abandoned. Therefore the origin is empty.","madhyamaka":"Samudaya svabhāvataḥ sat cet prahāṇam na upapadyeta. But removal IS observed → not inherent. Origin of suffering is removed (by the path) → not inherent.","accessible":"If the cause of your headache were \"inherent\" to you, no medicine could remove it. But medicine works → the cause isn't inherent.","twoTruths":"Conventionally: the origin of suffering can be abandoned (Second Truth). This requires emptiness of the origin.","commonMisconception":"NOT saying the origin is unreal. It's conventionally real. But its emptiness is what makes abandonment possible."},"quantumResonance":{"concept":"Inherent Forces → Can't Be Screened","score":50,"strength":"Medium","explanation":"Inherent force → can't be removed.
